name: candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick Chart
description: OHLC candles with solid green up and red down bodies, crosshair tooltips on hover or focus, optional volume, and an accessible data table.

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered label, open, high, low, close, and optional volume. Invalid OHLC records remain as gaps; negative prices are allowed.

props.name: showVolume
props.description: Show a separate normalized volume pane when valid nonnegative volume exists

props.name: onCandleClick
props.description: Pointer or keyboard activation with original data index

props.name: reaction
props.description: Per-chart emotion, metric, asset, and resolver overrides

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Message when no valid OHLC records remain

ai.purpose: Show within-period price movement and traded volume without losing OHLC information.
preferOver: A closing-price line when intraday range matters
